en.title: ASEAN e-commerce 2026: mobile retail, social commerce and payments
en.standfirst: How brands can enter the ASEAN e-commerce market by adapting to mobile-first retail, marketplaces, social commerce and local digital wallets.
en.metaDescription: How brands can enter the ASEAN e-commerce market by adapting to mobile-first retail, marketplaces, social commerce and local wallets such as GoPay and GCash.
en.body:
Brands assessing the **ASEAN e-commerce market 2026** need a country-specific approach to customer experience, sales channels and payments.

**Selling online in Southeast Asia** involves more than translating an existing website. Mobile checkout, marketplace participation, local-language support and **social commerce ASEAN** opportunities all deserve attention.

For businesses researching **Shopee and Lazada** seller entry options or **GrabPay GoPay integration**, start with the target market and the customers you intend to serve.

## The mobile-first market

Design the purchase journey around mobile use.

Review how product information, images, customer support and checkout work on a phone. A page that functions on a desktop may still create friction when customers need to read details, ask questions or complete payment on a smaller screen.

Shopping behaviour differs across ASEAN markets. The practical priority is to ensure mobile customers can complete the full transaction smoothly.

Prepare local-language support for the channels your customers will use, including marketplace chat or relevant messaging platforms.

## Marketplaces versus direct-to-consumer

Shopee, Lazada and Indonesia's Tokopedia are marketplace examples identified in this guide. A direct-to-consumer website provides another route.

Assess the options against your target country, product and operating arrangements. Before committing to a marketplace, confirm its current seller eligibility, onboarding and local entity or distributor requirements.

A marketplace presence and an independent store can form parts of the same strategy. Decide which channels you can support with appropriate product information, customer service, payment options and fulfilment.

Do not assume that a warehouse in your home market or a local third-party logistics provider is automatically suitable for every product. Assess delivery cost and timing for the proposed route.

## The rise of social commerce

Social commerce connects product discovery with interaction and purchasing. Live-selling and video content can allow customers to see products demonstrated and ask questions during the sales process.

The Google, Temasek and Bain research programme identifies video commerce as an important part of Southeast Asia's e-commerce development. [Google: e-Conomy SEA findings](https://blog.google/intl/id-id/company-news/outreach-initiatives/e-conomy-sea-2025-indonesia-memiliki-pertumbuhan-video-commerce-terbesar-di-asia-tenggara/)

Prepare content and presenters for the local audience, then confirm the selected platform's current selling arrangements.

Platform access and social-commerce regulation can change. Verify the operating model before investing in a campaign.

## Localising digital payments

Offer payment methods suited to the target market rather than assuming every customer will use a credit card.

Examples include GoPay in Indonesia, MoMo in Vietnam and GCash in the Philippines. Payment aggregators can provide access to selected local methods, but coverage varies by country and merchant eligibility.

Xendit's published guidance, for example, lists different supported wallets for different markets. [Xendit: Supported e-wallets](https://help.xendit.co/hc/en-us/articles/360032277491-What-are-the-supported-eWallets-by-Xendit)

Confirm availability for your entity and sales channel before promising a payment option. Where cash on delivery forms part of the proposed model, include it in the fulfilment and customer-service assessment.

zh.title: 2026東協電子商務：行動零售、社群電商與支付
zh.standfirst: 品牌如何透過行動優先零售、電商平台、社群電商及當地電子錢包，進入東協電子商務市場。
zh.metaDescription: 品牌如何透過行動優先零售、電商平台、社群電商，以及GoPay、GCash等當地電子錢包，進入東協電子商務市場。
zh.body:
評估**2026年東協電子商務市場**的品牌，需要針對各國分別規劃顧客體驗、銷售通路與支付方式。

**在東南亞進行線上銷售**不只是把現有網站翻譯成當地語言。行動結帳、電商平台參與、當地語言客服，以及**東協社群電商**的機會，都值得關注。

正在研究**Shopee與Lazada**賣家進駐方案或**GrabPay、GoPay整合**的企業，應先從目標市場及打算服務的顧客著手。

## 行動優先的市場

請以行動裝置的使用情境來設計購買流程。

檢視產品資訊、圖片、客服及結帳在手機上的運作情況。在桌機上能正常運作的頁面，當顧客需要在較小的螢幕上閱讀細節、提問或完成付款時，仍可能造成阻礙。

東協各市場的購物行為不盡相同。實務上的優先事項，是確保行動裝置顧客能順暢完成整筆交易。

請為顧客將使用的管道準備當地語言客服，包括電商平台聊天功能或相關的即時通訊平台。

## 電商平台與直接面對消費者的比較

Shopee、Lazada及印尼的Tokopedia是本指南所列的電商平台範例。直接面對消費者（D2C）的網站則是另一條途徑。

請依目標國家、產品及營運安排評估各種選項。在決定進駐某一平台前，請確認其目前的賣家資格、進駐流程，以及當地法人或經銷商方面的要求。

電商平台與獨立商店可以是同一策略的不同部分。請決定哪些通路是您能以適當的產品資訊、客戶服務、支付選項及履約能力支持的。

不要假設本國市場的倉庫或當地的第三方物流業者自動適合所有產品。請評估擬定路線的配送成本與時效。

## 社群電商的興起

社群電商將產品探索、互動與購買連結在一起。直播銷售及影音內容讓顧客可在銷售過程中觀看產品示範並提問。

Google、淡馬錫（Temasek）與貝恩（Bain）的研究計畫指出，影音電商是東南亞電子商務發展的重要一環。[Google：e-Conomy SEA研究結果](https://blog.google/intl/id-id/company-news/outreach-initiatives/e-conomy-sea-2025-indonesia-memiliki-pertumbuhan-video-commerce-terbesar-di-asia-tenggara/)

請為當地受眾準備內容與主持人，並確認所選平台目前的銷售安排。

平台存取與社群電商法規可能變動。投入行銷活動前，請先核實營運模式。

## 數位支付在地化

請提供適合目標市場的支付方式，而非假設每位顧客都會使用信用卡。

範例包括印尼的GoPay、越南的MoMo及菲律賓的GCash。支付整合服務商可提供部分當地支付方式的接入，但涵蓋範圍因國家及商家資格而異。

例如，Xendit公布的指引針對不同市場列出不同的支援電子錢包。[Xendit：支援的電子錢包](https://help.xendit.co/hc/en-us/articles/360032277491-What-are-the-supported-eWallets-by-Xendit)

在承諾提供某種支付選項前，請先確認其對您的法人及銷售通路是否可用。若貨到付款是擬定模式的一部分，請將其納入履約及客戶服務的評估。
